# Ambience

Wolfgate replacements for the Crescent biome and station music, swapped in a pool at a time. Tracks live in `Resources/Audio/_WG/Ambience` and are wired in through marked edits to the sound collections in `Resources/Prototypes/_Crescent/Music/ambient_music.yml`. Replaced so far: the Inner, Middle and Outer rings, the four Outer Cloud rings, and the INSO-357k and LINEAR-21 beacon clusters. Crocus, hyperspace, expeditions, stations and combat still use the Crescent tracks.
